about: Search text rules every platform holds to: the air date a query names (API.dateQuery, dateLabel) and the verbatim transcript snippet (API.transcriptSnippet). js/api.js is the reference; Apple and Android tests read this file.

snippets.text:
Good evening.

This is the story of a Martian landing near Grover's Mill, New Jersey, where the farmers saw a strange cylinder fall from the sky on a quiet night in October of nineteen thirty eight, they said.
  The end.
